seasons.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
seasons.note: French (bush) beans in the plains; October-November sowing = rabi.

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
days_to_first_harvest.quote: It is ready forharvest in 50 days after sowing.

harvest_span_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
harvest_span_days.quote: 9 - 10 t/ha of green pods in 90 - 100 days.
harvest_span_days.note: Crop over by 90 days: 90 - 50 = 40 days of picking.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_row_cm.quote: In plains, sow the seeds (2 seeds/hill) in the sides of the ridges at a spacing of 45 x 30 cm.

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_plant_cm.quote: In plains, sow the seeds (2 seeds/hill) in the sides of the ridges at a spacing of 45 x 30 cm.

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
water_need.quote: Immediately after sowing, third day and thereafter once a week.
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering once a week is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium', a continuous supply as 'medium' to 'high'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Well drained loamy soils with pH range of 5.5-6.0 is required.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: 9 - 10 t/ha of green pods in 90 - 100 days.
